scope: Credential hygiene gate based on the chat history only. No secret value, key fragment, fingerprint, environment variable, or local credential file was read or recorded.
finding: A Gemini API credential was pasted into the conversation. Current repository and evidence contain no owner confirmation that the disclosed credential has been revoked and replaced.
required_action: In the provider console, revoke the credential that was disclosed, create a replacement, and update only the intended server-side secret store. Do not paste the replacement into chat or repository. Confirm only that revocation and replacement are complete; do not provide the key.
